prose: Microsoft says a China-linked, state-aligned hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool called ARTEX to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise, as part of a broader campaign targeting hundreds of organizations, per Reuters reporting. The case is a prominent instance of state actors operationalizing AI offensive-security tooling at scale.
highlights: Microsoft attributes a ConnectWise compromise to China-linked hackers using an AI pen-testing tool, ARTEX
The campaign reportedly targeted hundreds of organizations
Reuters: a notable case of state-aligned actors using AI offensive tooling at scale
